description: This file contains helper functions and classes for environment configuration and build type detection in a CMake-based build system, including platform detection, environment variable checks, and build type inference.

classes.name: BuildType
classes.description: Class for determining and checking the build type (Debug, Release, RelWithDebInfo) based on environment variables and CMake cache.

methods.name: check_env_flag
methods.description: Checks if an environment variable is set to a truthy value like 'ON', '1', 'YES', etc.

methods.name: check_negative_env_flag
methods.description: Checks if an environment variable is set to a falsy value like 'OFF', '0', 'NO', etc.

methods.name: gather_paths
methods.description: Collects and concatenates paths from multiple environment variables.

methods.name: lib_paths_from_base
methods.description: Generates library paths based on a base directory.
